overall: No violation. The City had designated cityofeverett.com as its official notice posting location in 2018, so posting there satisfied the Open Meeting Law; the complaints were resolved.

allegations.summary: Alleged notices for the Nov. 1 and Nov. 15 meetings were posted only to cityofeverett.com, not ci.everett.ma.us, where prior notices appeared.
allegations.key_passage: Regardless of whether previous meeting notices had been posted to both websites, the Committee was under no obligation to post its meeting notices anywhere other than the official notice posting location.
